3lb Golden LME (Boil)

3lb Crystal 10. (Steep)

Wyeast 1056

My iPod got splashed with water, now it won't turn on. What do?
Put it in a bag/tub of rice and it will suck the moisture out. Might only work if it was splashed recently.

1. Chill.

  2. DONT TRY TO TURN IT ON.

  3. Toss that bitch in some rice, or a sunny window sill for about 3 days.

  4. Be cool. Ten it back on after 3 days or so.
I eleven mine back on after 3 days or so.

Assuming it wasn't on when it got wet, I'll bet you tried to turn it on right after it got wet, to see if it worked? Best thing is to keep it turned off, use the bag of rice trick to dry it out, and then turn it on a day or two later. If you turn it on while it is wet, or it is running while water gets inside, it will short circuit many of the connections.
